items.label: Payment timing
items.description: When customers pay: after they are served, before anything is prepared, or on a tab settled later.

allowed.label: Pay after service
allowed.description: Guests eat first and pay at the end. Best for the restaurant and bar.

allowed.label: Pay first
allowed.description: Payment is taken before the kitchen starts. Best for the poolside kiosk.

allowed.label: Open tab
allowed.description: Orders build up on a tab that is settled when the guest leaves.

items.label: Require an open cash session
items.description: Cash payments can only be taken while the cashier has an open cash-drawer session. Turning this off removes a key cash control.

items.label: Payments while offline
items.description: What the apps may accept when the connection to the property server is down. Card and transfer cannot be verified offline.

items.label: Waiters may hold cash
items.description: Waiters can collect cash at the table and hand it in at the end of their shift.

items.label: Waiter cash limit
items.description: The most cash one waiter may hold before handing it in. 0 means no limit.

items.label: Approval threshold
items.description: Amounts above this need a supervisor. 0 means every discount by a non-approver needs approval.

items.label: Refund approval threshold
items.description: Refunds larger than this need a supervisor.

items.label: Always needs approval
items.description: These actions always need supervisor approval from anyone who is not a supervisor, whatever the amount.

items.label: Allow open tabs
items.description: Customers can run a tab that is settled later.

items.label: Maximum tab
items.description: A tab cannot grow beyond this amount without settling. 0 means no limit.

items.label: When stock is deducted
items.description: SEND deducts ingredients when the order is sent to the kitchen or bar; SETTLE waits until the customer pays. SEND is safer for stock accuracy.

allowed.label: When sent to the kitchen
allowed.description: Stock drops the moment the order is sent. Most accurate.

allowed.label: When paid
allowed.description: Stock drops when the guest pays. Cancelled orders never touch stock.

items.label: Take orders while offline
items.description: Staff may keep taking orders when the connection is down; they sync when it returns.

items.label: Require a table
items.description: Every order must be assigned to a dining table.

items.label: Print receipts automatically
items.description: The app prints a receipt as soon as a payment is taken.

items.label: Receipt copies
items.description: How many copies the app prints for each receipt.

items.label: Receipt footer
items.description: Printed at the bottom of every receipt, for example opening hours or a thank-you line.
items.default: Thank you for visiting 007 Resort & Spa.

items.label: Hold time
items.description: How long a slot is held while the customer completes the booking and payment before it is released.

items.label: Minimum notice
items.description: Bookings must be made at least this long before the start time.

items.label: How far ahead
items.description: How many days ahead customers can book.

items.label: Free cancellation window
items.description: Customers can cancel free until this long before the start.

items.label: Late cancellation fee
items.description: Percentage of the booking total charged when cancelling inside the free-cancellation window.

items.label: Reschedules allowed
items.description: How many times a booking may be moved.

items.label: Slot length
items.description: The length of one bookable slot on the grid.

items.label: Booking while the site is offline
items.description: What happens to online bookings when the resort loses its connection to the cloud. Applies to every active bookable resource here.

allowed.label: A: Reserved pool
allowed.description: The site keeps taking bookings from a reserved share of units.

allowed.label: B: Online only
allowed.description: Bookings need the cloud. Blocked while offline.

allowed.label: C: Switch off online
allowed.description: Online booking is disabled while the site is offline.

items.label: Reserved pool for offline booking
items.description: For strategy A: the share of each resource the site may allocate while offline (rounded down; 0 = none).

items.label: Heartbeat stale threshold
items.description: After this long without a heartbeat from the cloud the site treats itself as offline for booking purposes.

items.label: Maximum occupancy
items.description: The most people allowed inside at once. Leave empty for no limit.

items.label: Daily opening time
items.description: The earliest time this facility takes orders.

items.label: Where customers pay
items.description: For facilities without a payment terminal: the facility where the customer pays (usually Main Reception).
